about: What each measure in portal.odcs.json means and how its values combine. metrics are the district and monthly summaries' (and, under their gear name, the gear summaries'); taxaMetrics are the taxa summaries'. A total adds up; an average combines weighted by what `weight` names (its measure, read from the collection `from` gives at the same district, month and other keys), districts first and then months, and falls back to the plain mean where no value has a positive weight; a share combines as a plain mean.

catch.description: the recorded catch behind each value

gps_tracker.label: GPS tracker
gps_tracker.description: Census boats × trips per GPS-tracked boat × catch per surveyed trip, per district and month. Catch per trip is averaged by boat and gear group, each counting for its share of the census boats (coasts 4.20.0), so it is not the plain mean_catch_kg. A district-month needs tracked trips and surveyed landings. Its confidence comes from sampling_rate: high from 0.3, medium from 0.1, low below; below 0.1 the dashboard shows no change on a year earlier.

fao_artfish.label: FAO ARTFISH
fao_artfish.description: FAO's OPEN ARTFISH method (de Graaf, Stamatopoulos & Jarrett 2017): census boats × days a boat fishes in the month, from the surveyed fishers' days fished last week × catch per surveyed trip, by boat group and gear group (boat type alone in Mozambique), then added up. Uses only the KEFS (Kenya), WF (Zanzibar) and DINAPA (Mozambique) trips. Since coasts 4.19.0. Its precision is in the API only, so the dashboard never shows the change of an ARTFISH figure on a year earlier.

mean_cpue.label: Catch per unit effort
mean_cpue.description: Each surveyed trip's catch divided by its fishers and its hours, averaged over the district-month's trips.
caveats: A falling rate can mean fewer fish, but also bad weather or a change of gear or fishing ground: read it as a warning sign, not a measure of the stock.

mean_rpue.label: Revenue per unit effort
mean_rpue.description: Each surveyed trip's catch value divided by its fishers and its hours, averaged over the district-month's trips.
caveats: Values are what fishers report at landing, not adjusted for inflation.

mean_catch_kg.label: Catch per trip
mean_catch_kg.description: Mean total catch of a surveyed trip.
caveats: Depends on which boats and gears are surveyed: where larger boats are surveyed more often, the catch per trip is larger.

mean_catch_price.label: Revenue per trip
mean_catch_price.description: Mean value of a surveyed trip's catch.
caveats: Covers the whole crew's catch, before fuel, gear or other costs.

n_fishers.label: Fishers per trip
n_fishers.description: Crew size: the mean number of fishers on a surveyed trip. Not the number of fishers in a district.

n_submissions.label: Landings surveyed
n_submissions.description: Landings recorded by enumerators and kept after validation.
caveats: Counts the sample, not all fishing trips: enumerators do not record every landing.

trip_duration_hrs.label: Trip duration
trip_duration_hrs.description: Mean length of a surveyed trip, as reported at landing.

mean_price_kg.label: Price per kg
mean_price_kg.description: Each surveyed trip's catch value divided by its weight, averaged over the trips; all species mixed.
caveats: All species are mixed, so a change in what is landed moves the price as much as a change in the market.

sampling_rate.label: Share of boats tracked
sampling_rate.description: Share of the district's census boats that carried a GPS tracker that month: the confidence of the GPS tracker estimates (high from 0.3, medium from 0.1, low below).
caveats: Combined, it is the plain mean of the district-months' shares, not the tracked share of the combined fleet.

estimated_fishing_trips.label: Estimated fishing trips
estimated_fishing_trips.description: Trips made by all the district's boats: census boats × trips per GPS-tracked boat.
caveats: Assumes tracked boats fish as often as the rest of the fleet.

estimated_catch_tn.label: Estimated catch
estimated_catch_tn.description: Catch landed by all the district's boats: estimated trips × catch per surveyed trip.
caveats: An estimate on two samples, surveyed landings and tracked boats: trust the order of magnitude and the trend more than the exact figure.

estimated_revenue.label: Estimated revenue
estimated_revenue.description: Value of the catch landed by all the district's boats: estimated trips × value of a surveyed trip.
caveats: Values are those reported at landing, not market or export prices.

estimated_fishing_trips_fao.label: Estimated fishing trips
estimated_fishing_trips_fao.description: Trips made by all the district's boats: for each boat and gear group, census boats × days fished, one trip a day; counted only where the catch is estimated.
caveats: Rests on fishers' memory of the days they fished.

estimated_catch_tn_fao.label: Estimated catch
estimated_catch_tn_fao.description: Catch landed by all the district's boats: for each boat and gear group, census boats × days fished × catch per surveyed trip, added up.
caveats: Counts only the boat and gear groups surveyed that month.

estimated_revenue_fao.label: Estimated revenue
estimated_revenue_fao.description: Value of that catch: for each boat and gear group, census boats × days fished × value of a surveyed trip, added up.
caveats: Values are those reported at landing, not market or export prices.

catch_kg.label: Recorded catch
catch_kg.description: Catch of the taxon at the surveyed landings.
caveats: The catch of the surveyed landings only; in Kenya the identified sample of each catch.

mean_length.label: Mean length
mean_length.description: Mean length of the taxon's measured fish, weighted by catch, in the district-month.
caveats: Lengths of different taxa do not combine.
In Kenya, the mean of the fish measured on each landing.

price_kg.label: Species price per kg
synonyms: price per kg of a species
price_kg.description: Value of the taxon's priced catch divided by its weight. Kenya prices each species; Zanzibar and Mozambique record one value per trip, so a species is priced only from trips that landed it alone (coasts 4.15.0).
caveats: Species mostly landed together with others can be missing or rest on few trips.

estimated_catch_tn_fao.label: Estimated catch by species
estimated_catch_tn_fao.description: The FAO ARTFISH estimated catch split by taxon: each boat and gear group's estimate in the species mix of the surveyed trips its catch per trip came from.
caveats: Has no GPS tracker twin, so it adds up every district-month ARTFISH estimates: its total can exceed the ARTFISH catch the dashboard compares with the GPS tracker method.
